headline: Usiminas Posts Third-Quarter Net Profit of 243 Million Reais
summary: Usiminas reversed a previous loss to post a net profit of 243 million reais in the third quarter, though the result came in below the IBES consensus estimate of 300.11 million reais.
why: Earnings reports provide direct visibility into the profitability, demand conditions, and cost structures of heavy industrial and steel manufacturing companies.

impacts.name: Usiminas
impacts.why: Missing consensus net profit estimates typically exerts downward pressure on the company's equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The company reported a net profit below analyst consensus expectations, triggering negative market reactions despite a return to profitability.
